title.ru: Present Perfect или Past Simple; for и since
title.en: Present Perfect or Past Simple; for and since
title.es: Present Perfect o Past Simple; for y since

pattern.en: I've lived here for five years.
I lived in Kazan for five years.
pattern.ru: Я жил в Казани пять лет (теперь нет).

text.ru: Если время названо и закончилось (yesterday, last year, ago, in 2020) — Past Simple. Если период длится до сих пор или время не важно — Present Perfect. Русское «живу здесь пять лет» = I've lived here for five years (не I live). for — длительность (for two hours), since — точка начала (since Monday, since 2020). Вопрос — How long have you…?
text.en: If the time is stated and finished (yesterday, ago, in 2020) — Past Simple. If the period continues to now or the time doesn't matter — Present Perfect. «Живу здесь пять лет» = I've lived here for five years. for = duration, since = starting point. How long have you…?
text.es: Tiempo terminado → Past Simple; hasta ahora → Present Perfect. for (duración) / since (desde).

rule.formula: Present Perfect + for (срок) / since (с момента) · Past Simple + yesterday / ago / in 2020
